component: PINNED_BROWSER_PROFILE (human documentary adjudication; not a crawler)

artifact.browser_family: Mozilla Firefox ESR (Extended Support Release), desktop
artifact.version_policy: each adjudicator records the exact installed ESR version (about:support 'Version') and the policy status (about:policies 'Active') in an installation attestation (forms/R08-installation-attestation.form.json) BEFORE their first block; the version may not change within a decision block; updates only between blocks, each recorded; both adjudicators must be on the same ESR major line
artifact.enterprise_policies: R08-firefox-policies.template.json installed as policies.json (extensions blocked, updates off during blocks, no password saving, no form history, no search suggestions, no accounts, telemetry off, sanitise on shutdown, private browsing forced)
artifact.session: one fresh private window per RDG; all windows closed and the browser restarted between RDGs; never logged in; no stored credentials; no history or personalised search carried between RDGs
artifact.cookies: refuse non-essential cookies where a choice is offered; if a consent wall requires accepting non-essential cookies to read the page, do not accept: the page is an access restriction and its evidence gap follows the frozen UNRESOLVED rules
artifact.timezone: record the OS timezone in the attestation; all evidence timestamps in UTC
artifact.network: UK egress (frozen UK-customer context); no VPN or proxy that changes country
artifact.navigation: start only from the frozen E1/E2 leads produced by R17 for the RDG's primary entry; follow only visible first-party links whose path contains a frozen vocabulary term; depth <= 2; eligibility 16 pages/60 min; terms 6 pages/20 min; one retry after >= 30 min (decision-protocol.json, unchanged)
prohibited: typed or guessed URLs other than the exact E2 leads
extensions, scripts, automation, crawling or bulk download
switching to another entry of the RDG
artifact.access_controls: respect technical and explicit access restrictions; never circumvent
artifact.evidence_recording: evidence-record.schema.json per consulted page (URL, UTC time, title, tier, proposition, predicate, code, reason, minimal excerpt where appropriate, adjudicator, record SHA256, optional existing archive pointer); no page copies or screenshots by default

version: specification 1.0.0 (installed ESR version recorded per adjudicator before first block)
controlling_clause: roles.json R08; decision-protocol.json navigation (browser, prohibited, vocabulary, budgets)
conditions: per-adjudicator installation attestations (exact version, policy status, OS timezone) must be recorded and anchored before that adjudicator's first block
conflicts_independence: none (profile); attestations are made by R05/R06

binding: Binding only when committed, annotated-tagged programme-a-freeze-1.2.1-pre-reveal and pushed; G1 remains on HOLD in this task.
